name: worker-fleet
description: Supervisor-side loop that keeps a fleet of Claude worker sessions busy. One tick sweeps every worker: it answers approval prompts (everything except merge), nudges the ones that have gone silent, advances the ones that finished, and starts one new worker in a free slot from a labeled issue. Capacity is re-measured every tick from free memory and CPU rather than fixed at startup. The implementation itself belongs to openspec-workflow and the review to pr-loop; this plugin owns capacity, classification, intervention, and dispatch.
